messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up on the RFC about attribute handoff between inference sidecars and obs-ingest — we need to lock a mode for billing keys vs other metadata. Can we pick one today?
Maria: +1. Two big axes: whether billing keys live in the root envelope (fast for cost pipeline) or are resolved later via lookup (smaller sidecars but more complexity).
Sam: What's our traffic shape here? If late-resolve hits often it could blow up lookup cost.
Jordan: Current telemetry: ~75% short traces (<1s), ~15% medium, ~10% long sessions. Most missing billing keys appear in long sessions started by older SDKs. Deterministic billing is the requirement.
Alex: Proposal: billing_key should be canonicalized into envelope.root when available. If absent, perform a fast cache lookup at ingest and populate envelope.root.billing_key with either the found key or null. Add a separate mechanism for late corrections (billing_patch events) instead of full reingest.
Maria: We need explicit state for consumers — provisional vs final. Suggest envelope.meta.billing_status = one of ["final","provisional","unattributed"] and envelope.meta.billing_source = one of ["sidecar","cache-lookup","patch"].
Sam: Concern: cache-miss churn could create lots of provisional items. Recommend a TTL and a max-retries policy; after N seconds mark as 'unattributed' so cost pipeline can bucket them instead of stalling.
Jordan: Agree. Also add a small version tag so we can trace which sidecar/proxy emitted the original attribute: envelope.meta.source_version. Makes debugging simpler.
Alex: Prototype rules (pseudo):
```
envelope.root.billing_key = sidecar.billing_key || cache.get(trace_id) || null
if sidecar.billing_key:
  envelope.meta.billing_status = "final"
  envelope.meta.billing_source = "sidecar"
elif cache.get returned key:
  envelope.meta.billing_status = "provisional"
  envelope.meta.billing_source = "cache-lookup"
else:
  envelope.meta.billing_status = "unattributed"
  envelope.meta.billing_source = "none"
```
Maria: Ops asks for metrics around the lookup path: lookup_latency_s, lookup_miss_count, provisional_ratio, patch_apply_failures. Also rate-limit cache lookups to avoid thundering herd.
Sam: For stitch/correction path: instead of reingesting full traces, publish a lightweight billing_patch event to a small topic with {trace_id, billing_key, timestamp, source}. cost-stitcher can consume and join by trace_id. That avoids double-ingest and OOO ordering issues.
Jordan: cost-stitcher will accept patch events and backfill attribution for traces within a configurable window (default 30s). After window expires, patches go to a manual correction queue.
Alex: Decision summary: 1) Canonical billing_key in envelope.root when available. 2) Fast cache-lookup at ingest to populate provisional keys. 3) Explicit billing_status + billing_source fields. 4) billing_patch event stream for corrections with bounded backfill window. 5) TTL/fallback to 'unattributed' after 30s default.
Maria: Action items: I'll open a schema PR adding billing_status, billing_source, source_version and tests.
Sam: I'll implement retry/ttl logic in the cache service and add the lookup metrics.
Jordan: I'll wire up cost-stitcher consumer for billing_patch and add config for backfill window.
Alex: I'll write the brief RFC follow-up and list these decisions/action items. Thanks team.
infra-bot: deploybot: schema PR #142 merged to staging — watch for schema validation alerts on ingest.
Maria: :thumbsup: noted, will monitor.
Jordan: I'll pick up the stitching work next sprint and report progress in this thread.
Alex: Thanks — closing thread once RFC follow-up PR lands.
